title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache & parallelism
author: Aisha Patel
description: Split the previous monolithic CI workflow into three focused workflows (lint, test, release) to improve build parallelism, reduce wasted compute on non-relevant changes, and simplify release automation. Motivation: large combined workflow was causing long queue times, frequent cache misses, and brittle release steps that block merges. This PR: 1) Introduces .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/tests.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml. 2) Moves platform-specific job matrices into smaller per-workflow matrices and uses dynamic job concurrency for PRs vs schedule runs. 3) Adds a lightweight cache helper script (scripts/ci/cache-helpers.sh) to standardize restore/save keys and fallbacks across repos. 4) Bumps GitHub Actions (@actions/checkout, setup-node, cache-actions) to supported versions and removes deprecated uses. 5) Improves action inputs to allow partial-run (skip lint on docs-only changes) and fast-fail for known flaky integration tests. 6) Tightens release automation: separate publish job with manual approval and rollback hook, improved tag naming and changelog generation. 7) Repo hygiene: removes unused legacy CI YAML, consolidates common steps into actions/tooling where appropriate. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and wire up concurrency controls - [x] Add cache key fallback and size-safe save - [x] Update action versions and audit for deprecated inputs - [x] Add docs/ci/README.md with runbook and troubleshooting - [x] Run full CI on redwood monorepo and fix failing tests (rerun after cache tweak) Testing and validation: ran full lint/test matrix on branch, observed 35% median reduction in runtime for PRs that touch a single package, re-ran failing integration test with increased timeout which stabilized flake. Linked Linear tasks: ENG-1724 (CI perf), ENG-1849 (Release automation hygiene). Notes: this is a behavior-preserving refactor for developers; no runtime or product-facing changes. Release automation change requires SRE team to add the manual approvers on the repo settings. See review conversation for requested follow-ups (small follow-up PR to add per-repo action pinning).
commits: Split workflows: add lint.yml, tests.yml, release.yml
Bump actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, cache-action pinning
Adjust matrices: reduce test matrix for quick PRs, extend nightly matrix
Fix flake: increase integration test timeout and add retry on HTTP flaky endpoint
review_comments: Ben Carter: Can we gate the heavier test matrix behind a path filter so docs-only changes don't queue it? Requested change: add path filters and a fast path for packages/* edits.
Aisha Patel (author): Added path filter and a quick-check job to tests.yml; heavier matrix now runs only if src/** or packages/** changed. See commit for the patch.
Claire Zhang: The cache key collision risk across workflows needs mitigation - please use repo + job + hash; also prefer explicit restore-keys for partial matches.
Aisha Patel (author): Updated cache-helpers.sh to include job name and workflow name in keys; added explicit restore-keys with fallback to last-successful in the org cache strategy.
Dmitri Ivanov: Release job looks good but we need a manual approval step in the workflow and a rollback hook. Also add a canary flag for dedicated customers.
Aisha Patel (author): Added workflow_dispatch approval step and a rollback job triggered by a workflow_run on failure; canary flag exposed via release inputs.

release_notes: Refactor CI: split monolithic workflow into lint/test/release; reduce PR runtime and improve cache reliability; bump GitHub Actions to supported versions; add release manual approval and rollback hook; docs added (docs/ci/README.md)
